name: 29 Palms Farmers' Market
description: 29 Palms Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 73484 Twentynine Palms Hwy, CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
